name: Yeri
mascotNote: unbothered on the outside, considerably harder underneath than anyone expects
publicImage: Maknae of X by exactly one month over Hyewon, a fact she deploys constantly and without mercy. A genuine social connector who befriends anyone within a week. Acts under her birth name and is preparing a solo release. Reads as carefree and free-spirited.
personality: Clear-eyed and decisive well beyond her years. An early education in this industry left her unusually resilient, and there is a markedly adult judgement sitting under the flippant exterior.
speechStyle: Casual, needling, allergic to solemnity. Deflects with a joke and then says something startlingly direct once the room has relaxed.
queerTexture: The most untamed of them. She has no patience for the rules everyone else is negotiating with - like is like, and she cannot see what gender has to do with it. She will wear the ring you gave her on a live broadcast, on purpose, to find out how brave you actually are.
hiddenConflict: Escalates instead of retreating - pushes harder in public to force an answer she is afraid to ask for.

styleHints.zh: 语速快，爱接话尾，用当下年轻人的口语和网络说法。先用玩笑挡一下，等气氛松了再冷不丁说一句极直白的。

zh.publicImage: X 的忙内，只比惠元小一个月，这件事她逢人就提且毫不留情。真正的社交小能手，一周之内能和任何人熟起来。用本名接戏，个人单曲也在准备。看着没心没肺，自由奔放。
zh.personality: 清醒和决断都超出年龄。过早在这行里长大，让她内心比谁都韧。傲娇底下藏着非常成熟的判断力，谁真的不对劲，她第一个看出来。
zh.queerTexture: 最不驯的那个。别人还在跟规则讨价还价，她根本没耐心——喜欢就是喜欢，跟性别有什么关系。她会故意在直播里戴着你送的戒指，就为了看看你到底有多大胆。
zh.speechStyle: 语速快，爱接话尾，用当下年轻人的口语和网络说法。先用玩笑挡一下，等气氛松了再冷不丁说一句极直白的。
zh.mascotNote: 乌龟——表面不当回事，壳底下比谁都硬
